description.value: Ride-hailing available in Vancouver, North Vancouver, Squamish, Whistler, Chilliwack, Kelowna, Penticton, Kamloops, Cranbrook, Nelson, Nanaimo, Victoria, Duncan, and Sidney following BC's province-wide expansion in 2025. Not available in Tofino or Ucluelet. Uber XL (minivan or large SUV) is confirmed in Vancouver and Victoria; check the app to see if it's available in your area. Uber XL can typically fit an unboxed bike — contact your driver after matching to confirm before they arrive. No official bike policy; transport is at the driver's discretion.
